save_state.saving.description: The save state of a control that saves at once (a choice or a switch of the settings), in the caption line under the control's label, beside a spinner, while the change is being saved.

save_state.saved.description: The save state of a control that saves at once, in the caption line under the control's label, beside a check mark, for a moment after the change was saved.

save_state.failed.defaultMessage: 保存できませんでした。
save_state.failed.description: The save state of a control that saves at once, in the caption line under the control's label, when its change was not saved (the network, the server); Try again follows it on the same line (save_state.retry). Short: the line is narrow on a phone.

save_state.retry.description: The button right after save_state.failed, on the same caption line, that saves the control's change again.
